steps.candidate:
# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes [note 0, 13].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].
- Standardize on axios for all outbound HTTP calls; use request/response interceptors for auth and retry logic [note 10, 11].

## Validation & Schemas
- Zod 4 (v4.0.5) is now in use; replaced `.strict()` with `z.strictObject()` for all schemas [note 9].
- Rewrite error-mappers to read Zod 4's specific `issue` list format, as it differs from Zod 3's `.flatten()` output [note 8].
- Credit-note payload schemas mirror invoice schemas to ensure consistent error handling [note 7].

## Logging & Observability
- Use Winston for structured logging; ops dashboard ingests Winston's format natively [note 6].
- Configure redaction paths (e.g., card numbers) in logging setup to prevent sensitive data leaks [note 5].
- Log external API retry attempts (e.g., BillingClient) at `warn` level [note 4].

## Code Quality & Pitfalls
- Enforce alphabetical import sorting via ESLint; catches merge conflicts early [note 1, 3].
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Express error handler returns 400 for validation failures and 500 for other errors [note 1].

# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes [note 0, 13].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].

## Validation & Schemas
- Zod 4 (v4.0.5) is the validation library; use `z.strictObject()` instead of `.strict()` [note 9].
- Zod 4 validation covers query parameters in addition to body payloads [note 12].
- Rewrite error-mappers to read Zod 4's specific `issue` list format, not Zod 3's `.flatten()` [note 8].
- Credit-note payload schemas mirror invoice schemas for consistent error handling [note 7].

## Logging & Observability
- Pino is the logging standard; winston was reverted after two data-loss incidents under load [note 11, 14].
- Configure redaction paths (e.g., card numbers) in pino setup to prevent sensitive data leaks [note 5, 9].
- Log external API retry attempts (e.g., BillingClient) at `warn` level [note 4].

## Outbound HTTP
- Use plain `fetch` for all outbound HTTP; axios is forbidden by security policy [note 10].
- BillingClient uses a hand-rolled retry wrapper on fetch; integration suite verified parity with old axios client [note 10].

## Code Quality & Pitfalls
- Imports are grouped by type: node builtins, external packages, internal aliases, relative paths [note 7, 15].
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- Express error handler returns 400 for validation failures and 500 for other errors [note 1].
